verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents resolving errors, including auto-resolve of unresolved errors when a deploy is recorded, and a Slack button to resolve or reopen an error. That covers only the resolve/reopen slice of triage. Reopening is shown only as a manual action, with no evidence of automatic regression detection. Missing for 10: assigning an owner, ignore, snooze, documented automatic reopen of a resolved issue on regression, and independent corroboration.
